introduction: The following special conditions apply specifically to this project and supplement the standard terms.

terms.title: Site Access Requirements
terms.content: The client agrees to provide clear access to the site during working hours (Monday to Friday, 08:00 - 18:00) for the duration of the project. Any access restrictions must be communicated at least 48 hours in advance.

terms.title: Project Documentation
terms.content: All project documentation will be provided in digital format via the Noble Architecture Project Portal. Physical copies of drawings may be requested at an additional cost of £25 per A1 print.

terms.title: Planning Application Support
terms.content: This quotation includes liaison with the Local Planning Authority during the application process. Attendance at planning committee meetings, if required, will be charged at the standard hourly rate.
